summary: TicketSwap is online marktplaats voor concertkaarten, founded in 2012. Type: startup / scale-up. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: Amsterdam marketplace for safely reselling tickets; senior and finance roles in English, all with pay shown.

culture.text: Runs a marketplace where fans safely buy and sell tickets they can't use.
Finance team handles high transaction volumes across markets and is building a modern function using automation and AI.
Calls itself an international platform with a clear mission and strong brand.

open.text: All 3 current Amsterdam jobs here don't require Dutch, 2 of 3 mention visas or relocation, and all show pay.

worth_knowing.text: Founder Hans Ober stepped back, saying it briefly no longer felt like his company.
New minimum-price rules mean last-minute tickets will no longer go for rock-bottom prices.
